CREATE TABLE `pagbank_logs` (

  `timestamp` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `method` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `endpoint` varchar(255) NOT NULL,

  `order_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `charge_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `reference_id` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `empresa_id` int(11) DEFAULT 1,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_timestamp` (`timestamp`),
  KEY `idx_payment_type` (`payment_type`),
  KEY `fk_empresa_pagbank_logs` (`empresa_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_empresa_pagbank_logs` FOREIGN KEY (`empresa_id`) REFERENCES `empresas` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=199 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_uca1400_ai_ci
